description: Read-only sh fixture playbooks for tests/playbooks_sh.rs (Phase E section 7.8). None of them changes system state: they print, sleep, read their IA_PARAM_* environment and their stdin, or start a sleeping child that the process-group kill must take with it. They run in a temp run dir the test creates and write nothing outside it.

playbooks.name: echo params
playbooks.body:
echo "host=$IA_PARAM_HOST count=$IA_PARAM_COUNT leak=[$IA_PARAM_LEAK]"
echo 'to stderr' >&2
echo "cwd=$(pwd)"
exit 3

playbooks.name: stdin is empty and the body is not readable
playbooks.body:
if read -r line; then echo "stdin=[$line]"; else echo 'stdin=eof'; fi
cat >/dev/null
echo 'after cat'

playbooks.name: lots of output
playbooks.body:
i=0
while [ $i -lt 4000 ]; do echo "line $i of the output cap test"; i=$((i+1)); done

playbooks.name: ignores SIGTERM
playbooks.body:
trap '' TERM
echo armed
while :; do sleep 1; done
